guscent.title: Guscent
guscent.summary: A design-led perfume storefront that turns mood-based storytelling and a scent quiz into a clear product-discovery and commerce journey.

bullets.highlight1: Built a smooth e-commerce storefront with mood-based storytelling using Next.js and React.
bullets.highlight2: Integrated headless CMS and REST APIs for flexible content and stable data flows.
bullets.highlight3: Shipped responsive UI and SEO-ready pages to production with a team of three.

highlights.shipped: Next.js App Router storefront: scent quiz, dynamic catalog/cart, checkout hooks, and CMS-driven editorial/product sections with reusable layout primitives.
highlights.decisions: Server Components + route-level data fetching; Zod-validated REST integration; accessible quiz state machine; resilient loading, empty, and error boundaries for headless CMS payloads.
highlights.impact: Production launch with responsive UI kit, optimized media, and a component architecture the team can extend without redesigning pages.

uctalent.title: uctalent.io & business.uctalent.io
uctalent.summary: SaaS HRTech platform — talent marketplace and recruiter workspace for sourcing, pipelines, AI-assisted matching, semantic search, and referral flows; designed RBAC and role-based permissions across the UC Talent ATS.

bullets.highlight1: Owned full-stack ATS modules with Next.js, NestJS, GraphQL, and PostgreSQL in production.
bullets.highlight2: Implemented semantic search with Elasticsearch, vector embeddings, and AI-assisted matching workflows.
bullets.highlight3: Designed RBAC and tenant-scoped permissions for recruiter, admin, and candidate roles.
bullets.highlight4: Shipped multi-tenant SaaS ATS model with isolated recruiter workspaces, tenant-scoped data, and production subscription flows.

highlights.shipped: SaaS marketplace and ATS modules: recruiter workspace, candidate pipelines, screening, AI matching, outreach, referrals, and tenant-scoped admin tooling.
highlights.decisions: Designed RBAC and permission matrices for recruiter/admin/candidate roles; PostgreSQL schema migrations and seed strategies; Elasticsearch + vector embeddings for semantic search; GraphQL across NestJS, FastAPI, Redis queues, and background workers.
highlights.impact: Production HRTech platform with role-gated ATS flows, evolvable data model, and shared search/matching services under full-stack ownership.

unchainlabs.title: Unchain Labs
unchainlabs.summary: A production marketing site and headless CMS that lets the team publish structured business content without frontend rework.

bullets.highlight1: Delivered a Next.js marketing site with Strapi headless CMS and TypeScript end to end.
bullets.highlight2: Modeled dynamic zones, editor RBAC, and PostgreSQL-backed content with safe migrations.
bullets.highlight3: Launched SEO-ready production site so editors publish without frontend redeploys.

highlights.shipped: Next.js marketing site, Strapi content types, dynamic zone sections, media library workflows, validated contact API, and editor-friendly preview flows.
highlights.decisions: SSR/SSG hybrid with semantic HTML; Strapi RBAC for editor roles; PostgreSQL-backed CMS with migration-safe content models; sitemap, robots, Open Graph, and per-environment config.
highlights.impact: SEO-ready production site where non-developers publish structured pages without frontend redeploys.

matchtutors.title: Match Tutors
matchtutors.summary: A tutor–student marketplace that brings profiles, scheduling, AI-assisted matching, realtime chat, and payments into one workflow.

bullets.highlight1: Built a React + TypeScript marketplace with scheduling, chat, and PayOS checkout in production.
bullets.highlight2: Implemented realtime Socket.io messaging and BullMQ workers on Redis for async AI matching.
bullets.highlight3: Deployed capstone to AWS with Docker, JWT/OAuth auth, and split frontend/backend repos.

highlights.shipped: Tutor/student profiles, scheduling, session management, PayOS checkout, JWT + Google OAuth, S3 file uploads, and Socket.io messaging with live booking updates.
highlights.decisions: MongoDB collections with indexed query paths; OpenAI embeddings + BullMQ workers on Redis for async matching; Express middleware auth; Dockerized AWS deploy with env-specific secrets.
highlights.impact: Capstone shipped to AWS with realtime chat/booking, queued AI matching, and a split React + Express codebase ready for iteration.
